g1.necessity: SubAgent/worker execution previously had no mechanical answer to 'which physical worker may commit results for the current generation', so a crashed worker's late writes could race a replacement worker — a physical-ownership fact the model cannot verify from outside.

g2.authority_owner: new fleet mechanical identity plane (src/llm_loop/fleet), reusing service_control store conventions (closed schema, fcntl lock, atomic replace)
g2.non_duplication: Does not duplicate service_control deployment binding (services vs execution workspaces), job_registry (local background jobs), or subagent_topology (child sessions); it adds the missing workspace-generation fencing authority only.

g3.recovery_or_reason: Any coordinator can rebuild full state from disk; nothing is held only in memory; revert removes the whole authority with no data migration.
